body:
Hi @e-krebs
we don't guarantee we reuse the DOM across renders (destroying or reusing DOM is decided by our component abstraction Preact).

Here when you click on a DOM element, we mutate the DOM and sometimes destroy the checkbox instead of reusing it.
If you want to hook some specific behaviour to the component after a refine call, I would advise creating your own component on top of the connector, so that you have full control on the DOM.

I hope this helps. Closing for now but feel free to reopen if i missed something.
